chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 380: Ji Ning's Bait-and-Switch Slaughter of the Flamewing Demon King
chapter_meta_description: The Dongliu Twelve Demon Kings surround Ji Ning. After a masterful deception, he assassinates their third member in a single, brutal blitz, revealing his true strength and shattering their formation.
og_title: Desolate Era 380 – Ji Ning's First Kill Among the Twelve Demon Kings
og_description: A shocking betrayal of expectations! Ji Ning lures the Flamewing Demon King into a false sense of security, then obliterates him in a devastating display of pure sword power.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 380: The Art of the Xianxia Feint
twitter_description: Ji Ning plays the fool, then strikes like lightning. The Flamewing Demon King is dead before the other eleven can react. A masterclass in tactical deception.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary group of twelve great demon lords ruling the Star Continent, feared even by Celestial Immortals when they fight together as a formation.
The third-ranked Demon King; a powerful great demon who tormented the imperial Qi clan and was killed by Ji Ning in a surprise attack.
The leader and most famous of the Dongliu Twelve; notably has the lowest karmic sin among them, marking him as an anomaly and a deeper threat.
A soul-based perceptual power normally unlocked at the Primal Daoist stage, allowing telekinetic control and omni-directional awareness; Ji Ning uses it here for tactical reconnaissance.
Ji Ning's newly accepted disciple; broke with the imperial Qi clan and now sees her master as the only family she has left.
A precious escape treasure allowing instant teleportation, but requires a brief activation time during which the user is vulnerable.
A visible aura of blood-light and vengeful spirits that clings to cultivators who have massacred innocents; detectable by Ji Ning's powerful divine sense.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning pretend to be weak instead of fighting at full power immediately?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He correctly deduced that the twelve Demon Kings had a joint formation that would be devastating if they fought together. By luring one into a solo fight, he neutralized that advantage and killed the third Demon King before the others could react.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the meaning of the Goldfur Bear Demon King having low karmic sin?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It marks him as an anomaly among the twelve—either he is a hidden master who avoids unnecessary slaughter, or he is simply too clever to leave obvious karmic traces. Ji Ning notes this as a reason for heightened caution.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of 'Trial by Combat' in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning deliberately restricts himself to pure sword technique and a lower power level, hiding his true divine abilities (like the Starseizing Hand) and final Trump cards. This is a classic Xianxia tactical feint to mislead stronger enemies.
